summary: Junior Data Analyst Intern, SkillzenLoop: A paid internship opportunity to work on live analytics and dashboarding projects, with a stipend of ₹15,000 per month.
responsibilities: Collect, clean, and validate datasets to ensure data quality
Assist in Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to extract insights
Build dashboards and visual reports using Power BI / Excel / Tableau
Support data-driven decision-making with meaningful metrics
Work with SQL to extract and transform data from database sources
Create weekly and monthly performance summaries
Maintain documentation and ensure structured data workflows
required_skills: Strong knowledge of Excel and comfort working with data
Basic understanding of SQL and Python (Pandas/NumPy) is preferred
Analytical mindset with good attention to detail
Clear communication skills and interest in business insights
Eagerness to learn tools and practices used by data teams
qualifications: Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, BCA, BBA (Analytics) or similar
benefits: Opportunity to work on live analytics and dashboarding projects
Mentorship from senior data & BI professionals
